scenes.prompt:
Environment-only background photograph for a premium Etsy listing image (square), professionally art-directed advertising.
Campaign mood: Poetic, romantic twilight-meadow calm with heirloom craft-table intimacy; refined rather than whimsical, letting the crochet texture lead..
Palette: Warm oat linen, parchment cream, dusty blush, sage green, muted mauve and antique brass, with soft shadowed plum accents to flatter the approved artwork..
Lighting: golden evening light; Low golden window light with gentle side shadows, creating a quiet late-afternoon studio glow..
Scene: A warmly lit oat-linen crafting table with an antique brass snip, a softly blurred ceramic vessel and a few loose sage-green yarn strands in deep background. Build cinematic depth with a warm cream foreground and muted plum shadows. Keep the entire right half clear, bright and uncluttered for the product composite; leave the left third calm for copy.
Composition: keep the right-hand two thirds of the frame as a clear, empty, softly lit surface with natural depth, where an object will be placed later. Keep the left area calm and darker for text added later.
Photographic and realistic: shallow depth of field, cinematic warm light, restrained premium styling, no clutter.
Do NOT include: flowers of any kind, bouquets, crocheted or knitted items, amigurumi, finished handmade objects, anything made of yarn except plain skeins, patterns, charts, printed pages, paper, books, notebooks, screens, text, letters, numbers, words, logos, watermarks, people, hands, animals, any card-, page-, sheet-, book- or print-like rectangle, any mock product.
